entities.summary: Justis Huni is an Australian professional boxer. He challenged for the WBA interim heavyweight title in 2025. At regional level, he has held multiple heavyweight championships, including the Australian title from 2020 to 2021. As an amateur, Huni won a bronze medal at the 2019 World Championships.
